# Sowing dates

Rough dates for the plot, counted back from the last frost in mid-May. Tomatoes and peppers start indoors in March, on the sunny windowsill. Peas and broad beans can go straight into the soil in February. Courgettes and squash wait until the nights are warm. Carrots are sown every three weeks from April to July so that they do not all mature together.

Beetroot and lettuce prefer cool weather and bolt in a heatwave, so the last sowing is in early August. Garlic goes in around All Saints. I tick each line in the seed box when it is done and write the actual dates next to the plan.

A cold spring shifts everything by a fortnight.
